reference.notes:
I implemented the spec, and all 120 tests in the package pass. That covers both build-commit suites and the existing schema tests, and the TypeScript compile has no errors.

**Changes:**
- **`packages/shared/src/build-info.ts`**: the schemas and `unknownBuildInfo` were already written, so I only filled in the five function bodies:
  - `formatVersion` gives `"<version> (<first 7 of commit>)"`, or just `"unknown"` when both the version and the commit are unknown.
  - `isIdentified` is true whenever `commit` is not `"unknown"`.
  - `commitUrl` removes trailing `/` from the repository, then one trailing `.git`, and appends `/commit/<full sha>`. It returns `undefined` if the commit or the repository is unknown.
  - `sameBuild` is true only when both builds have a known commit and the commits are equal, so two unknown builds never match.
  - `buildBanner` trims the name and throws `TypeError("A build banner needs a name.")` if it ends up empty. Otherwise it returns `"<name> <formatVersion>"`, plus `" built <builtAt>"` when the build time is known.
- **`packages/shared/src/index.ts`**: added `export * from "./build-info.js";`.

I didn't touch any tests, config or other files.
